node.label: US 10-year yield
node.up: Borrowing for a decade got more expensive — every valuation on earth resets
node.what: The world's discount rate. Roughly the average overnight rate expected over ten years plus a premium for the risk of holding it that long. Every valuation model starts here: when it rises, cash flows far in the future are worth less today, and the companies whose profits are furthest away fall the most.
